description: Change-feed for monitoring a live run: the timeline events since a timestamp, plus a cursor to poll with. MCP has no push, so poll again with since=cursor. Optional kinds[] to filter event kinds (e.g. ['verdict','skeptic-escalation','failed']).

runId.description: The run's full runId (slug-date-codename) OR just its codename.

since.description: Poll cursor — a stable sequence number from a prior call's `cursor` (preferred), OR an ISO timestamp for the first call. Returns only newer events; omit for the full timeline.

name: run_changes
